Security Effect v0.14 commit revalidation demo
==============================================
Status: NOT EXECUTED IN THIS PACKAGING ENVIRONMENT

The shipped executable demo is examples/commit_revalidation_demo.rex.
Expected semantic path (not recorded as execution evidence here):
  original START invocation -> Security ALLOW
  host records origin execution evidence -> continuation
  exact staged state -> fresh COMMIT assessment ALLOW
  new ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER_CONFIRMED evidence -> COMMIT assessment HOLD
  unchanged staged operation is therefore not allowed to commit under the stale original admission.

Run the demo under the package's qualified ooRexx runtime before promotion.
